title: [KVCache] Add Triton software NVFP4 KV cache support
body_opening:
## Purpose

This PR adds Triton backend support for `--kv-cache-dtype nvfp4`.

NVFP4 stores KV cache as E2M1 FP4 data plus E4M3 block scales. This Triton path performs the FP4 packing and unpack/dequant in software, without relying on native FP4 conversion instructions.

The practical benefit observed below is roughly **3x KV cache capacity** on Qwen3.6-27B and Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, with MRCR quality comparable to the `auto` KV baseline and closer to that baseline than the TQ 4bit_nc reference in the same completed 30-sample runs.

## Usage

```bash
# Auto-selects the Triton path when native FlashInfer NVFP4 KV is unavailable.
vllm serve <model> --kv-cache-dtype nvfp4

# Or select it explicitly.

Add a Triton module that computes MiniMax-M3 sparse indexer context scores independently per context-parallel (CP) rank, opt-in and decoupled from the global DCP configuration.

title: Add separate post-thinking sampling parameters
body_opening:
## Summary

This PR adds support for using a separate set of sampling parameters after a model finishes its `<think>...</think>` reasoning block.

The primary motivation is models such as **Qwen 3.8 27B**, where the optimal sampling parameters for reasoning differ substantially from the optimal parameters for the final answer.

In testing, Qwen 3.8 27B benefits from a relatively high temperature (`~0.9–1.0`) during reasoning. Lower temperatures can cause the reasoning process to become repetitive or enter loops. However, keeping that same temperature after `</think>` noticeably reduces the reliability and precision of the final response, including normal chat output and tool calls.

title: [ROCm][GPT-OSS] Fuse RoPE + static Q FP8 quant on fused RoPE+KV path
body_opening:
## Summary

- Add a dedicated compile-time fusion for `RoPE(q, k) -> static Q FP8 quant -> KV-cache update`.
- Reuse `fused_rope_and_unified_kv_cache_update` for the RoPE + KV-cache update portion, then apply static Q FP8 quantization to the fused Q output.
- Keep ROCm AITER rotary pattern matching aligned with the lowered op signature by passing `offsets=None` only for the AITER triton rotary op.
- Add targeted compile-pass coverage for the new RoPE + static-Q-FP8 + KV-cache fusion path.

## Motivation

For GPT-OSS style decode graphs, RoPE, static Q FP8 quantization, and KV-cache update appear adjacent in the hot path. Keeping RoPE + KV-cache update on the existing fused primitive

title: Add Triton fused MoE config for B200 (Nemotron Nano)
body_opening:
## Purpose

When running Nemotron Nano on B200 the following warning appears:
```
Using default MoE config. Performance might be sub-optimal!
Config file not found at .../vllm/model_executor/layers/fused_moe/configs/E=128,N=1856,device_name=NVIDIA_B200.json
```

I used the `benchmark_moe.py` to create a JSON file for this use-case:
```
export MODEL_PATH=/my_home/hf_models/nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3-Nano-30B-A3B-BF16

python benchmarks/kernels/benchmark_moe.py \
  --model $MODEL_PATH \
  --trust-remote-code \
  --tp-size 1 \
  --tune \
  --batch-size 1 2 4 8 16 24 32 48 64 96 128 256 512 768 1024 1536 \
  --save-dir /.../vllm/model_executor/layers/fused_moe/configs/

```
